text.content:
Ashwake Hollow is one road, one toll-gate, and a dead signal-tower on the ridge above it. Everything that crosses the pass crosses here, and everyone who lives here knows it.

All toll business runs through @UUID[Compendium.ashwake-hollow-oneshot.actors.Actor.4e3dd5ad90e47600]{Rook Vantle}. Nothing goes up the pass, or comes down it, without his book knowing.

• A cart in the yard is listed against a drover who died two winters ago.
  • Rook pays quietly for word of anything moving up the pass after the gate is shut.
